speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an infant experiencing recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing. To help me understand what might be causing these symptoms, can you tell me if these breathing difficulties occur more frequently during feeding, crying, or when you lie on your back?

REQUEST TEST: CBC (Complete Blood Count)
REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-ray: Evidence of tracheal compression and a vascular ring suggestive of a double aortic arch; CBC: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Double Aortic Arch. The chest X-ray findings of tracheal compression and a vascular ring are characteristic of this congenital vascular anomaly, which explains the recurrent stridor and wheezing, particularly during feeding or crying when the airway is most compressed.
